messages.content: What are the main attributes of the <frameset> tag?
The main attributes of the <frameset> tag include rows, cols, frameborder, and border.
What is the purpose of the <frame> tag in HTML?
The <frame> tag is used to create a new window or tab within a web page.
What are some common browser issues with frames?
Common issues with frames include compatibility issues across different browsers, performance issues, and security concerns.
What are the main attributes of the <iframe> tag?
The main attributes of the <iframe> tag include src, width, height, frameborder, and scrolling.
What are the main types of block elements in HTML?
The main types of block elements in HTML include div, p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, ul, ol, dl, pre, blockquote, address, and form.
What are the main types of inline elements in HTML?
The main types of inline elements in HTML include span, a, img, br, em, strong, b, i, u, s, sub, sup, and input.

What are some common font size units in HTML?
Common font size units in HTML include pixels (px), ems (em), rems (rem), and percentages (%).
How do you set the font size in HTML?
You can set the font size in HTML using the `font-size` property. For example, `

>This is a paragraph.

What is the difference between relative font size units like em and rem?

Em units are relative to the font size of the parent element, while rem units are relative to the font size of the root element (usually the `<html>` element). This makes rem units more flexible and easier to maintain.
What are the main attributes of HTML forms?
Form attributes include action, method, enctype, and target.
What are the different types of HTML form controls?
HTML form controls include text input, checkboxes, radio buttons, dropdowns, and more.
How do you create a single-line text input control in HTML?
You use the <input> tag with the type attribute set to 'text'.
What are the attributes of the Password Input controls?
The attributes of the Password Input controls include 'type', 'placeholder', 'required', and 'autocomplete'.
What are the attributes of the Multiple-Line Text Input Controls?
The attributes of the Multiple-Line Text Input Controls include 'rows', 'cols', 'placeholder', 'required', and 'autofocus'.
What are the attributes of the Checkbox Control?
The attributes of the Checkbox Control include 'type', 'name', 'value', 'checked', and 'disabled'.
What are the attributes of the Radio Button Control?
The attributes of the Radio Button Control include 'type', 'name', 'value', 'checked', and 'disabled'.
What are the main types of form controls mentioned in the HTML documentation?
The main types of form controls mentioned are select boxes, attributes, file upload boxes, buttons, and hidden form controls.
What are the attributes of the <embed> tag mentioned in the HTML documentation?
The attributes of the <embed> tag mentioned are src, type, width, height, and pluginspage.
What are the supported video types for the <embed> tag mentioned in the HTML documentation?
The supported video types for the <embed> tag mentioned are mp4, ogg, webm, and wmv.
What is the purpose of the <embed> tag mentioned in the HTML documentation?
The <embed> tag is used to embed multimedia content into an HTML document.
What are the main attributes of the <marquee> tag in HTML?
The main attributes of the <marquee> tag in HTML include direction, behavior, and scroll amount.
What is the purpose of the <title> tag in HTML?
The <title> tag in HTML is used to specify the title of the webpage, which appears in the browser tab.
What is the purpose of the <meta> tag in HTML?
The <meta> tag in HTML is used to provide metadata about the HTML document, such as character set, viewport settings, and description.
What is the purpose of the <base> tag in HTML?
The <base> tag in HTML is used to specify the base URL for all relative URLs in the document.
What is the purpose of the <link> tag in HTML?
The <link> tag in HTML is used to link the HTML document to external resources, such as stylesheets or scripts.
What is the purpose of the <style> tag in HTML?
The <style> tag in HTML is used to define the style of the HTML document, including colors, fonts, and layout.
What is the purpose of the <script> tag in HTML?
The <script> tag in HTML is used to embed JavaScript code within the HTML document.
What are the different types of style sheets mentioned in the HTML document?
The different types of style sheets mentioned in the HTML document are external style sheets, internal style sheets, and inline style sheets.
What are the different types of JavaScript mentioned in the HTML document?
The different types of JavaScript mentioned in the HTML document are external JavaScript, internal script, and event handlers.
What is the purpose of the <noscript> element in HTML?

The <noscript> element is used to provide alternative content for users who have JavaScript disabled in their web browsers. It allows developers to specify content that will be displayed if JavaScript is not supported or if it is turned off.
What is the default scripting language for HTML?
The default scripting language for HTML is JavaScript. However, other languages like Python, Ruby, and PHP can also be used for scripting purposes.
What are some common HTML layout techniques using tables?

Common HTML layout techniques using tables include using the <table> element to create a grid of rows and columns, and using the <tr> (table row), <th> (table header), and <td> (table data) elements to define the structure of the table.
What are some common HTML layout techniques using DIV and SPAN elements?

Common HTML layout techniques using DIV and SPAN elements include using the <div> element to create a block-level element that can contain other elements, and using the <span> element to create an inline element that can be used to apply styles to specific parts of a text.
What are some common global attributes in HTML?

Global attributes are attributes that can be applied to any HTML element. Some common examples include 'id', 'class', 'style', 'title', 'lang', and 'dir'. These attributes provide a way to add metadata to HTML elements.
What are some specific attributes for the <a> tag in HTML?

The <a> tag in HTML has several specific attributes that can be used to define its behavior and appearance. Some common examples include 'href' (the URL the link points to), 'target' (where to open the link), 'rel' (the relationship between the current document and the linked document), and 'download' (to allow the user to download the linked file).
What is the HTML <article> tag used for?
The HTML <article> tag is used to define a self-contained, independent piece of content that can be distributed independently from the rest of the page.
What are some global attributes in HTML?
Global attributes are attributes that can be applied to any HTML element, such as 'id', 'class', 'style', and 'title'. They provide additional information about the element.
What are some event attributes in HTML?

Event attributes are attributes that trigger a JavaScript function when a specific event occurs on an HTML element, such as 'onclick', 'onmouseover', and 'onkeydown'. They are used to create interactive web pages.
What is browser support for the HTML <article> tag?
The HTML <article> tag is supported in all modern browsers, including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge.
What is the purpose of the <base> tag in HTML?
The <base> tag specifies the base URL for all relative URLs in a document. It sets the default URL from which all relative URLs are resolved.
What is the difference between <bdi> and <bdo> tags in HTML?
<bdi> is used to isolate parts of text that are written in a different direction or script, while <bdo> is used to force text to be displayed in a specific direction or script.
What is the purpose of the <bgsound> tag in HTML?
The <bgsound> tag is used to play a background sound in a webpage. It is similar to the <audio> tag but is only supported in Internet Explorer.
What is the difference between <big> and <small> tags in HTML?
<big> is used to make text larger, while <small> is used to make text smaller. The size of the text is relative to the default size of the text.
What is the purpose of the <caption> tag in HTML?
The <caption> tag is used to provide a title or description for a table. It helps visually identify the table and provides context for its content.
What is the difference between the <center> and <div> tags in HTML?

The <center> tag is used to center text within its parent element, while the <div> tag is a block-level element that can be used to group and style content. <center> is less flexible and is generally discouraged in modern web development.
What is the purpose of the <code> tag in HTML?
The <code> tag is used to define a piece of computer code. It is typically used to display code snippets, syntax highlighting, or to indicate that text is a code element.
What is the purpose of the <col> and <colgroup> tags in HTML?
The <col> tag defines a column in a table, while the <colgroup> tag defines a group of columns. These tags are used to specify the width and alignment of columns in a table.
What is the purpose of the <dd> tag in HTML?
The <dd> tag in HTML is used to define the description of a term in a definition list. It is typically used in conjunction with the <dl> (definition list) and <dt> (definition term) tags.
What is the difference between <del> and <s> tags in HTML?

The <del> tag is used to indicate text that has been deleted from a document, while the <s> tag is used to indicate text that is no longer relevant or accurate. The <del> tag is more commonly used for deletions, while the <s> tag is more commonly used for strikethrough text.
What is the purpose of the <dfn> tag in HTML?
The <dfn> tag in HTML is used to define a term. It is typically used in conjunction with the <dl> (definition list) and <dt> (definition term) tags to provide a definition for a term.
What is the purpose of the <dialog> tag in HTML?
The <dialog> tag in HTML is used to create a dialog box or a modal window. It is typically used in conjunction with the <button> and <form> tags to create interactive dialog boxes.
What is the purpose of the <em> tag in HTML?
The <em> tag is used to emphasize text, indicating that it has a strong emphasis or importance.
What is the difference between <embed> and <object> tags in HTML?

The <embed> tag is used to embed multimedia content, such as videos or audio, directly into the HTML document. The <object> tag is used to embed multimedia content, but it allows for more control over the content's appearance and behavior.
What is the purpose of the <fieldset> tag in HTML?
The <fieldset> tag is used to group related form elements together, providing a visual separation and making it easier for users to navigate the form.
What is the purpose of the <figcaption> tag in HTML?
The <figcaption> tag is used to provide a caption for a <figure> element, which can be used to display images, videos, or other multimedia content.
